})\n  }\n}\n\n// 处理截图输入对话框取消\nconst handleScreenshotCancel = () =&gt; {\n  console.log(&#39;[截图→AI] ❌ 用户取消了截图问答&#39;)\n  screenshotDataUrl.value = &#39;&#39;\n}\n\n// 监听scale变化，重新计算布局\nwatch(\n  () store.pageLayouts = layouts\n      // 更新状态适配器\n      stateAdapter.setPageLayouts(layouts)\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(&#39;重新计算布局失败:&#39;, error)\n    }\n  },\n)\n\n// /* 确保页面项不会被压缩，允许横向溢出 */\n  min-width: fit-content;\n  width: 100%;\n  /* 防止flex压缩 */\n  flex-shrink: 0;\n}\n\n.loading-overlay,\n.error-overlay {\n  position: absolute;\n  top: 0;\n  left: 0;\n
